name: Vector Jab
description: Jab along a laid line of force so the fist travels the shortest road to the target.

name: Vector Step
description: Step along a straight vector drawn in the air and stop exactly where it ends.

name: Vector Gauge
description: Read the line and speed of every body moving near and the vector each will follow.

name: Vector Bind
description: Lay opposed vectors across a foe's limbs so each effort to move is pulled back.

name: Vector Cut
description: Draw a vector through the foe and cut along it so the wound follows the line.

name: Vector Brace
description: Set a counter vector against an incoming blow so its force is cancelled in the air.

name: Vector Lance
description: Hurl a lance of qi down a precise vector so it pierces everything along its path.

name: Vector Reversal
description: Reverse the vector of a hostile strike so it travels back to its sender along the same line.

name: Vector Tempest
description: Lay a hundred lines of force through the foes' space and loose them together in a storm of cuts.

name: Axis Jab
description: Jab from a fixed axis so the whole body turns behind the fist.

name: Axis Walk
description: Walk round an axis set in the ground and end at the foe's side.

name: Axis Guard
description: Turn on the axis of the spine and let a blow roll off the curve of the body.

name: Axis Feel
description: Feel the axes about which nearby bodies turn and know where each will swing next.

name: Axis Twist
description: Twist the space about a foe's spine and pull their strike off its line.

name: Axis Thrust
description: Thrust along the axis of the forearm so the blow drills through a guard.

name: Axis Poise
description: Set the body upon a firm axis so each spin and turn carries more force.

name: Axis Hold
description: Fix a foe upon an axis of space so they turn but cannot leave the spot.

name: Axis Whirl
description: Spin the whole field round a central axis and sweep every foe off their feet.

name: Axis Shatter
description: Turn the foe on a great axis until the strain breaks their stance and their technique together.

name: Knot Fist
description: Strike with a fist wound in a knot of space that tightens at the instant of impact.

name: Knot Slip
description: Slip out of a loop of space just before it pulls tight and land beyond it.

name: Knot Feel
description: Feel where space has been knotted by another user and judge how tight each knot is.

name: Knot Snare
description: Tie a knot of space about a foe's ankles that tightens with every pull.

name: Knot Tighten
description: Draw a knot about the foe's chest tighter with each breath until the ribs give.

name: Knot Ward
description: Tie a heavy knot of space across the front of the body to catch a blow in its coils.

name: Knot Web
description: Leave a web of loose knots in the air that tie themselves round the first foe through.

name: Knot Unravel
description: Loosen a binding of space or rope from an ally by drawing each knot apart.

name: Knot Collapse
description: Tie a vast knot of space among the foes and draw it tight so everything within is crushed to its centre.

name: Thread Thrust
description: Jab a fist down a thread of space strung between the user and the target.

name: Filament Step
description: Pull the body along a drawn thread to a mark a long stride away.

name: Thread Read
description: Run a thread of qi out to a distant body and read its weight and movement from the tug.

name: Thread Shot
description: Cast a needle along a strung thread so it hits the mark with no drift.

name: Thread Bind
description: Loop a thread of space about a foe and draw it taut to pin the arms.

name: Thread Screen
description: Hang a screen of threads before the body to snag and turn aside a thrown weapon.

name: Thread Walk
description: Walk along a thread strung across a wide gap as if it were firm ground.

name: Thread Snare
description: Leave fine threads strung across a path that draw tight on any body that touches them.

name: Thread Rending
description: Draw a thread of space through the foe's body and pull it out through the far side.

name: Weft Palm
description: Strike with a palm laced with crosswise strands of space that bite on contact.

name: Weft Step
description: Pass between two strands of the weft and come out beyond the foe's guard.

name: Weft Guard
description: Weave a quick screen of strands before the chest to break the force of a blow.

name: Weft Feel
description: Feel the weave of space about the user and learn where a hidden body has torn it.

name: Weft Net
description: Cast a net woven of space strands over a foe so each struggle tightens it.

name: Weft Cut
description: Draw a taut strand through the foe like a wire through soft clay.

name: Weft Draw
description: Draw the strands of space tight about the user so each strike runs along a firmer line.

name: Weft Shroud
description: Wrap the body in a close weave that lets lesser blows pass through unfelt.

name: Weft Shear
description: Pull a great sheet of strands across the field and shear every foe in its path.

name: Weft Streak
description: Streak along a single strand to the far end of the field and land a blow as the body arrives.

name: Chord Blow
description: Strike along a chord drawn from the hand to the target's chest.

name: Chord Step
description: Step straight across a chord of space and skip the ground in between.

name: Chord Sense
description: Draw a chord to a distant body and feel its length to know how far away it stands.

name: Chord Cut
description: Cut along a chord so that everything between hand and target is parted.

name: Chord Snap
description: Snap a chord through a foe's charge and throw their stride off balance.

name: Chord Guard
description: Stretch a chord across the line of attack so the blow is cut away from the body.

name: Chord Lance
description: Send a lance down a chord that holds it straight over a great range.

name: Chord Seal
description: Draw chords round a foe in a closed figure that holds their qi inside.

name: Chord Severance
description: Draw a vast chord across the field and sever all that lies on it then hold the survivors down.

name: Torsion Palm
description: Strike with a palm that twists the space under it so the blow wrenches as it lands.

name: Torsion Step
description: Twist the space ahead and step through the twist to come out at an angle.

name: Torsion Sense
description: Feel the twist that a spatial attack leaves in the air and trace it to its source.

name: Torsion Wring
description: Wring the space about a foe's limbs so each arm is forced to turn against its joint.

name: Torsion Crush
description: Twist the space about a torso tight and drive the breath from the lungs.

name: Torsion Cloak
description: Twist a coat of space about the body so blows are wrenched away to the side.

name: Torsion Drive
description: Drive a spinning spike of twisted space through guard and bone.

name: Torsion Bind
description: Hold a field of twisting space over a group so each movement within it is a struggle.

name: Torsion Rend
description: Wrench the space within a foe's body until it tears from inside and armor cannot stop it.

name: Dilated Palm
description: Swell the space about the palm so the strike lands with a longer and heavier sweep.

name: Dilated Step
description: Swell the ground beneath the stride so each pace carries the body twice as far.

name: Dilated Guard
description: Swell the air in front of the forearms so a blow must cross more space to land.

name: Dilated Sense
description: Swell the range of the senses outward until a wide field of bodies lies open to them.

name: Dilation Slow
description: Swell the space about a foe so every step takes far longer to cross.

name: Dilation Strike
description: Swell the space between fist and target at the last instant and let the blow land with extra run.

name: Dilation Draw
description: Swell the space about the user's limbs so each movement has more room and more power.

name: Dilation Cushion
description: Swell a deep bank of space before the user so heavy strikes lose their force crossing it.

name: Dilation Wave
description: Send a wave of swelling space outward that hurls foes back and spreads them wide.

name: Dilation Bloom
description: Swell the space of a whole field until it bursts outward and breaks every stance within.

name: Loop Jab
description: Jab into a loop of space and let the fist come out beside the foe's head.

name: Loop Step
description: Step round a small loop of space and arrive at the point where the step began.

name: Loop Gauge
description: Feel the length of a loop another user has made and judge where it will close.

name: Loop Snare
description: Throw a loop of space over a foe's shoulders and draw it tight about the arms.

name: Loop Return
description: Bend the path of a thrown weapon into a loop that carries it back at its thrower.

name: Loop Strike
description: Throw a blow into a loop of space so it lands from behind the foe's back.

name: Loop Chain
description: Chain three looped blows each landing from a different side of the foe.

name: Loop Seal
description: Close a loop of space about a foe so any step they take returns them to the same spot.

name: Unending Loop
description: Bend a great stretch of space into a loop that returns each foe to the start and grinds them down.

name: Parallax Jab
description: Jab at a place a hand's width from where the fist seems to be heading.

name: Parallax Pace
description: Step so the image of the body lags a pace behind the true one.

name: Parallax Sense
description: Compare how a foe appears from two angles and learn where they truly stand.

name: Parallax Lure
description: Shift the apparent place of the user so a foe commits to a blow at empty air.

name: Parallax Cut
description: Cut at the true place of the foe while they guard against the place they see.

name: Parallax Cover
description: Shift the seeming of the guard so a blow lands a hand's width off the body.

name: Parallax Double
description: Show a second body at the foe's flank and strike from the true one at their front.

name: Parallax Veil
description: Hold the seeming of the body off from its true place so strikes pass where it appears.

name: Parallax Shift
description: Shift the body wholly out of the space it occupies and let a strike pass through where it stood.
